name: Restrofood Lite – Online Food Ordering System
author: themelooks

sections.description:
Restrofood Lite is an online food ordering and delivery system plugin for WordPress. You can manage your restaurant & other food ordering stuff with Restrofood. It has plenty of amazing features. That helps you to build a successful online business.

🔗Explore More | 🔗Explore Add-Ons

📦 RestroFood Lite – Free Version Features

⭐ Core Ordering & Checkout

  • Easy WooCommerce-based food ordering system.
  • Ajax Quick Product View, Search, Category Filter, and Pagination.
  • Same-page cart & checkout (fast ordering experience).
  • Delivery/Pickup selection and time slot options.
  • Minimum order amount settings (order placement restriction).
  • Free shipping options based on order amount.

🎨 Customization & Compatibility

  • Works with all WordPress themes & page builders.
  • Theme color change options.
  • Nice & customizable plugin settings panel.
  • Ready for translation with .pot file included.
  • Fully compatible with WordPress 6+ and WooCommerce.

🛠 Order & Delivery Management

  • Basic order management features included.
  • New order notifications.
  • Delivery time slot settings with break time support.
  • Delivery type selection: Pickup & Delivery.

📋 Admin & Backend Tools

  • Error-free code with free updates
  • Well documented for easy setup.
  • Includes a free restaurant theme demo.

🆓 Additional Free Benefits

  • Free WordPress.org support.
  • Unlimited food items & orders supported.
  • Ajax Quick Search & filters make browsing smooth.

💎 RestroFood Pro Version & Add-Ons Features

🚀 Advanced Ordering & Management Enhancements (Features typically only in Pro and with Pro add-ons)

🔗Get Pro Now

Core Pro Features

  • Advanced Product Extra Options (up-sell & combo extras)
  • Order Tracking System (real-time customer tracking)
  • Custom Email Templates & HTML Support for order status notifications
  • Notification Sound for new orders
  • Orders Statistics & Advanced Filters for order management

Advanced Delivery & Shipping Controls

  • Distance Restrictions (delivery only within set range)
  • Auto-Detect Customer Address & Google-style directions for delivery men
  • Zip Code-Based Delivery Areas
  • Advanced Delivery Scheduling (date/time slots with break times)
  • Closing Time Detection & Pickup/Delivery Time Window Controls

🧰 Pro Add-Ons (Extend Plugin Functionality)

🏢 Multibranch Add-on

  • Unlimited Branch Creation
  • Branch-Specific Product Display
  • Order Transfer Between Branches
  • Branch Hours, Holidays, & Pickup Time Sets
  • Day-Based Delivery Scheduling
  • Branch-Based Custom Delivery Fee Add Option
  • Branch-Wise Location Set Option
  • Branch-Based Distance Restrict
  • Zip-Code Based Delivery Areas
  • Independent Dashboard for Each Branch
  • Branch-Wise Order History and Reporting

🍽️ 🛍️ POS (Point of Sale) Add-on

  • Multiple Counter Creation
  • Multi-Branch Management
  • Branch-Wise User Assignment
  • Online & Offline POS Mode
  • Barcode Generation
  • Comprehensive POS Invoice System & Customization

🧾 Automatic Order Invoice Printing Add-on

  • PrintNode-based Instant Printing (thermal & regular printers)
  • Unlimited Printer Support
  • Custom Labels, Header/Footer, Logos

🍽️ Table Reservation Add-on

  • Fully Customizable Reservation Form
  • Multi-Branch Reservation Support
  • Unlimited Tables & Time Slots
  • Reservation Status Management (approved, cancelled, pending)

🚚 Multi-Delivery Fees Add-on

  • Multiple Delivery Fees (km/zip-based)
  • Automated Delivery Fee Rules
  • Seamless WooCommerce & WP Integration

💰 Tips Management Add-on

  • Percentage or Fixed Tip Options at checkout
  • Unlimited Tips Adding System

🍽️ In-Restaurant Orders Add-o

  • Dine-in Order Taking by Table Number
  • Real-Time Order Tracking for Staff

Privacy Policy

Restrofood Lite – Online Food Ordering System uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
The easy way.

Go to your WordPress Dashboard. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and then search for “Restrofood Lite”. Click on Install and then Activate the Plugin.

That’s it, Restrofood Lite Plugin is now activated on your site!

The hard way..

Download “Restrofood Lite WordPress Plugin” and then extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation and then activate the Plugin from Plugins page.

Yes
